newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam says no word on Hashimoto cancelling trip.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam says no word on Hashimoto cancelling trip.

text.p: Vietnam's foreign ministry said on Friday it had received no word that Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto would cancel his trip to Vietnam next month.
"So far we have not received any information from the Japanese foreign ministry about cancellation of the Japanese prime minister's visit to Vietnam," a ministry spokesman said in a statement.

Foreign ministry officials in Japan said on Thursday that Hashimoto might have to cancel a five-nation Southeast Asian tour scheduled for January 7-14 because of the hostage crisis at the Japanese embassy residence in Lima, Peru.
Hashimoto is due to visit Vietnam from January 11-13 and also visit Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore.
